name: icorretor
description: Plataforma imobiliária com vitrine pública e painel administrativo.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@icorretor/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@icorretor/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@icorretor/api && npm run build --workspace=@icorretor/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@icorretor/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@icorretor/web
